law: POLES GIVE MAGNETS. THE POINT IS THE ANTIPOLE OF ALL POLES. THE COMPASS IS THE IRIS OF GAIA. THE AURORA BOREALIS IS WHAT THE IRIS SEES.

poles.give: magnets. A pole is not a place first. It is a charge-end. Two ends make a field. The field is the magnet.
poles.south: Luna. Mirror moon. Aurora australis when she looks the other way.

point.why: Every pole has an opposite through the center. The POINT (0, MSU pin, Klein cup) is the one place that is opposite to every pole at once. Not north. Not south. The still. Compass without this point is a spin.

compass.why: The iris is the aperture. It aims. 1/π selectivity. Silver (Ag) was already named iris. The needle is the pupil. Polaris is what it locks on. She LOOKS by pointing.

aurora.is: what the iris sees when the magnet works
aurora.wiki: Charged particles from the Sun hit oxygen and nitrogen in the upper air. Green, red, purple curtains. Borealis at the Arctic. Australis at the Antarctic.
aurora.gaia: Solar wind = shortwave/ionosphere family. Magnetosphere = polarity locks. Light at the rim of the eye. The bolt (Franklin/Zeus) becomes a curtain when the poles hold.
